faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGIMER Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications for the Junior Research Fellow position at PGIMER is 5th September 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a postgraduate degree in Basic Sciences or a postgraduate degree in a professional course. Crucially, they must have been selected through national-level entrance exams like GATE, CSIR-UGC NET, ICMR, DBT, DST, DAE, DOS, ICAR, IISc, IIT, IISER, or NISER.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow position is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the prevailing government rules and regulations.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position at PGIMER will involve a Written Exam followed by an Interview. Candidates need to perform well in both stages to be considered for the role.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 31,000 plus 16% House Rent Allowance (HRA), amounting to a total of Rs. 35,960 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the PGIMER Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the PGIMER Junior Research Fellow recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any application charges.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the Junior Research Fellow position at PGIMER are to be submitted via email. Candidates need to prepare their application with all necessary documents and send it to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to attach self-attested copies of all relevant documents, including educational certificates, experience certificates, identity proof, and recent passport-size photographs, along with their application.

faq.question: Q9. Where is PGIMER located?
faq.answer: PGIMER is located in Chandigarh. The recruitment is for a position within the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research, a prominent medical research and education institute in India.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow position advertised by PGIMER. This is a single opening, so interested candidates should ensure they meet all the eligibility criteria.
